title: Take the Reins (2025)
description: GridCo Europa inherits the mainland backbone: coal-heavy Germany and Poland, nuclear France, gas in the Low Countries, and the real 2025 renewable base — the flex journey (batteries, electrolysis, caverns) arrives with its unlock years.
_why_world_not_build: The inherited backbone is authored (scripts/../author_start) and pinned as a golden so milestone 1's incident lands on a known fleet. Recipes that describe a SITUATION rather than a legacy use `build.metros` instead.
